newsitem.title: USA: Millbrook Capital says affiliate submits slate.
newsitem.headline: Millbrook Capital says affiliate submits slate.

text.p: Millbrook Capital Management Inc said Thursday that its affiliate, MMI Investments L.L.C., has submitted to the Eastern Co a slate of three nominees to the board of Eastern.
The slate is for nomination at Eastern's 1997 annual meeting.
Eastern has established February 28th as the record date for the meeting, which is expected to be held in April. MCM has retained D.F. King & Co Inc to assist it with its efforts.
MCM said it expects to file proxy material with respect to the elections of the nominees with the Securities and Exchange Commission in due course.

MCM, the owner of about 6.61 percent of Eastern's common stock, intends to replace Eastern's incumbent nominees with three new directors committed to enhancing value for all Eastern shareholders, MCM said. The MCM slate consists of MCM's chairman, John S. Dyson, its president, Clay Lifflander, and George Scherer, president of B.W. Elliott Manufacturing Co.

MCM, based in Millbrook, NY, is an investment firm owned by John S. Dyson. MCM specializes in the acquisition and management of middle market companies. Until recently, Mr. Dyson served as deputy mayor for finance and economic development of New York City. Ernst Ohnell, a participant in MCM's solicitation with respect to the MCM slate, is the founder and CEO of Ohnell Capital Corp, which is in the merchant banking business.
